residuals: Official context assessments and the 1000-note synthetic still require explicit budgets; defaults remain safety limits.
Work-only expansion with the default 64 MiB is insufficient for those fixtures.
B5-PERF-01 remains open; no unrestricted-readiness or global-linearity claim.
Unknown/overlapping/reordered fallback and output-size-dependent costs remain bounded by finite quotas.
Buffered-byte accounting is logical retained storage, not exact peak Go heap.
Original-DTD source boundaries, external resources and physical performance/engraving interpretation remain separate.
